evidence: 103 named assertions, each prefixed with its criterion id; the suite fails if any criterion is uncovered, if a name repeats, or if it exits before completing.

criteria.text: Disabled Sony performs no probes or process work and start is nonblocking/idempotent.
An unhealthy sidecar without an executable is absent and uses the approved 60-second dormant health interval.
A healthy existing endpoint is adopted as external and is never stopped or killed.
Managed launch is loopback-only and uses the configured absolute executable with fixed port arguments, cwd, shell false, and drained pipes.
Owned readiness failure and unexpected exits clean up/restart only within the bounded resettable crash budget.
Startup loads approvals, discovery leaves unknown cameras unapproved, and only explicit successful connect persists approval.
Approved cameras reconnect through a shared bounded discovery scheduler and forget cancels future automatic work.
Per-camera operations serialize while read polling coalesces or receives typed retryable backpressure.
Stop cancels work and gracefully shuts down only owned children before signal fallback.
Safe IDs allow alphanumeric, colon, and dash forms; upstream paths preserve literal colons after encoding validation.
Pairing is emitted only for exact injected numeric allowlist codes; ordinary outages remain disconnected/degraded.
Status and logs are curated and omit executable paths, raw logs, credentials, tokens, and fingerprints.
